verdict.rationale: monday's docs show users can operate the product via natural language: messaging/@mentioning agents in updates to kick off real work, and describing workflows in plain language to create agents, with goals/rules defined in NL. This directly supports AI-native NL-driven operation, though it's entirely first-party documentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that NL commands reliably execute intended actions, and detail on breadth/accuracy of NL command coverage across the product.
